title: Unit Event — Light Up the Fire — Episode1 Echoes Of The Third Event

meta.Episode: Episode1 — Echoes Of The Third Event
meta.Event Outline: Vivid BAD SQUAD's explosive third event has roused expectations that the team might actually surpass RAD WEEKEND. That's when Taiga summons them for "an important conversation"...

rows.Line: Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: (We're seeing their true capabilities here.)

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: (A part of me has been wondering this whole time...)

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: If anyone's going to surpass what happened that night, I'd have to say...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: It's been three years since that night...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: (I guess it's about time I fulfilled my promise...)

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: (Once the cafe service ends, I'll close up the place and go find them...)

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: (Based on how Taiga was behaving, I bet he's also going to want to say something before he leaves...)

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Still...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Kids sure do grow up fast, Nagi...

rows.Speaker: Regular
rows.Line:
Hey, Ken!
Everything okay? You look concerned.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Oh, I was just thinking about something.
What'll it be? The usual?
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Alright, Akito, An!
Here are your sandwiches and coffee.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Toya, here are your cookies and coffee.
You ordered the tea and pancakes, right, Kohane?! Enjoy!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: This is...

rows.Speaker: Akito & An
rows.Line:
Delicious.
Amazing!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Way to go, Rin! You said you made this mustard sauce yourself? It's got a kick to it, and it goes so well with the ham!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I think you're all set to fill in for MEIKO whenever she's not around!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
You definitely delivered on your words.
This is really good. Nice work.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Heehee! Of course it is!
This is a piece of pie for us!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I wasn't sure how you'd do in MEIKO's place, but I guess my worries were misplaced.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Also, Len, this coffee you made is very good.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah, I agree!
And my mouth can't believe how fluffy these pancakes are.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Heh. This was nothing!
Feel free to order from me anytime!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Anyway... You guys are gonna watch the video of your third event after you eat, right?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh... That's right!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Our plan was to watch it with everyone...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But it sounds like MEIKO and the others aren't gonna be back for a while. So, call it a little reward for making all this delicious food for us.

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: Woohoo!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wow, look at Kohane's solo!
You sound amazing!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe... Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I was really nervous about it at first... But, everyone gave me the push I needed to stand up there on my own.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You really did put on an outstanding performance, Azusawa. You had me transfixed.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Same here.
It sorta reminded me of the way RAD WEEKEND began...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Wh-What? Are you talking about Nagi...?!
No, what I did was nothing compared to...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Relax. I said sorta.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But you did put on a pretty incredible performance.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Th-Thanks...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Yeah, she sounded amazing...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Kohane just keeps getting better and better. In other words, she's getting closer and closer...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (To Aunt Nagi. To her level...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (But what about me...?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(No, stop.
Don't beat yourself up.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(I can get there too...
No, I will get there...!)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wooow!!!
That was such an amazing event!!!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And when the four of you sang at the end...! That was so mind-blowingly cool!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, that was probably the best performance you guys have ever put on!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks, you two!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Next time, we'll put on another performance like this one... No, we're gonna do even better.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah, I'm sure we can!
I mean, all the locals seem really excited about seeing our next event...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Speaking of which, it seems like more of them have been coming to talk to us since our last one. Their expectations of us must've increased quite a lot...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh... Yeah!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: The guy from the record store even told me that everyone from around town thinks we might have what it takes to actually surpass RAD WEEKEND!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Really?
Hehe. That's so nice...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's nice that we're finally getting noticed, but it also means that we can't let our guard down.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right. Let's keep doing our best moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So, are you guys gonna practice here after this?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, we're meeting up with some people, so we actually need to get going soon.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Who are you meeting?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Uncle Taiga asked us to meet him with Arata and the others this evening.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Taiga did? Why?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
We don't actually know exactly.
But he said it's something important...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Something important? Like what...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He'll be leaving to go on his US tour soon, so he may be leaving us with some parting words...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What?! A US tour?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, he's heading back to the US.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Really? But that's so far away...
Which is all the more reason to see him before he leaves!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: There could also be something else he wants to say. I mean, who knows what that guy's thinking most of the time...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, it's almost time for us to meet up with Tono and the others. We gotta go.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay.
Thanks again, you two! We'll be back soon!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: See you! Have fun!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Alright, let's start cleaning up!
After all, MEIKO said that our job's not over until the cups and stuff are all back on the shelves.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Right!
Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Isn't this An's handkerchief?
Did she forget it?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh... Well, I guess we'll just have to give it back to her next time.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hmm... But what if we forget...?
Shouldn't one of us go let her know it's here before we do?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Good point! Then, wanna go tell her?
Just don't get seen by anyone, okay?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Got it!
I'll be right back!
Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, there he is! Uncle Taiga!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Hey, sorry for asking you all to meet so suddenly...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, it's our pleasure.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But we were a little surprised to hear that you have “something important” to talk about. Also, there's like no one else here...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: It's nice, right? I come here occasionally when I need to get away from things. It's my little secret spot.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: But you're not here to tell us about this spot of yours, are you...?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Haha. You're always in such a hurry.
There are a few things that I need to tell you all, so I'll cover them one at a time...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: First, you may've already heard from Little Miss Diva here... But I'll be returning to the US to go on tour.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: The guys over there have been hounding me about not coming back sooner. To be fair, I have been here for a while now.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Was that my fault...?
Did teaching me keep you from going back...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: If so, I'm really sorry for taking up so much of your time...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
There's no need for you to apologize.
I stayed because I wanted to.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: And I was rewarded for doing so.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Rewarded...?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Your third event.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: You guys put on a great event, and I'm genuinely glad that I was able to see it before I left.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Th-Thank you very much...!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: And it seems like you know understand what it means to “take a good look at this city”.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Y-Yes!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I understand the importance of all the people who want to hear us sing, and wanting them to listen to our music...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Their support is the source of our strength... I think that's what you meant!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
A quick student takes all the fun out of it...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? No, I... I-I'm sorry!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
I was just kidding.
Anyway, you put on a great event. I haven't felt a shiver down my spine like that in a long time.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Which is why...there's something I need to tell you all now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Huh...?
Tell us all what...?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: That as things are, your dream will never come true.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: As you all are now, even if you spend your whole lives trying, you'll never surpass RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Never.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Uncle Taiga...?
